kyoto_hitsuji_donuts.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-dough donuts, including a whole-wheat donut (2026 reviews).
kyoto_hitsuji_donuts.vegan_detail: Ask. Natural-yeast donuts in kinako, brown sugar and hojicha; no ingredient list is published, and the cream and chocolate-custard donuts are filled (2026 reviews).
kyoto_hitsuji_donuts.hours_raw: Thu and Fri 11:30–18:00, Sat 11:00–18:00; closed Mon–Wed and Sun, plus occasional breaks including summer, announced on Facebook (Tabelog). A numbered-ticket system: on Saturdays people queue from before 9:30 and tickets for 15-minute slots are handed out from about 10:00; later in the day slots can run hours ahead (July–October 2026 reviews). Up to five donuts per ticket, made to order (October 2026 review). A small eat-in counter for about 3–4 (July 2026 reviews), though Tabelog notes the café closed in 2015. Electronic money accepted, no cards (Tabelog). About 7 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 25 September 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_hitsuji_donuts.notes: [Sweets · near the Imperial Palace, Kyoto's queued-for donuts] A small white-awninged shop where owner Takahiro Shimomura, once of the bakery Hohoemi, makes natural-yeast donuts: chewy, light, gently sweet, rolled in Tanba black bean kinako, brown sugar or hojicha, and best eaten warm. It is a numbered-ticket affair: on Saturdays the line starts before 9:30, tickets go out around 10:00 for timed slots, and each ticket buys up to five donuts, fried to order. A few counter seats let you eat one hot with a latte. Open Thursday to Saturday only; from about ¥330.

chef_bio.chef_name: Takahiro Shimomura (October 2026 review: "the owner, Mr. Takahiro Shimomura")
roles: Owner, makes the donuts (October 2026 review: "all processes managed by the owner")
chef_bio.background: Per October 2026 reviews: the owner previously ran a bakery called "Hohoemi", now closed, and opened Hitsuji in September 2011; the name stands for something fluffy, gentle, warm and happy. In September 2026 the menu was renewed: round donuts only, brown sugar instead of wasanbon, and donuts made to order per ticket (October 2026). Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023 (Tabelog). A September 2026 diner notes the shop Assemblage Plus next door.
chef_bio.specialty: Natural-yeast donuts; Tanba black bean kinako.

anecdotes.text: "With one ticket, you can purchase up to five donuts." — October 2026.
"There are only four counter seats for dining in, so you might have to wait a bit." — July 2026.
"The freshly made ones are the best, so I recommend eating them soon after purchase." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ひつじ、ドーナツ・カフェ、中京区大炊町355-1、丸太町駅から徒歩約7分、木・金11:30〜18:00、土11:00〜18:00、月・火・水・日休み、夏休みなど臨時休業は Facebook で、9席、電子マネー可・カード不可、テイクアウト、2011年9月25日オープン、2015年9月29日でカフェは終了との記載、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018・2019・2020・2022・2023。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): 天然酵母のドーナツ、整理券制、1枚で5個まで、揚げたて、2026年9月から丸い形と黒糖に、店主の Takahiro Shimomura さん、小さなイートインのカウンター。

kyoto_shinrin_shokudo.gf_detail: Ask. Spice curries on multigrain rice, but the daily line-up changes and some plates carry fried or battered toppings such as hamo tempura (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shinrin_shokudo.vegan_detail: Ask. The 2026 curries were meat- or fish-based (chicken, pork, duck, wild boar, bonito soup), with egg salad on the plate; no vegan curry is mentioned.
kyoto_shinrin_shokudo.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 and dinner 18:00–20:00 (Tabelog); open irregularly, also closing for catering jobs — check the business calendar on the official site, where a blank day means closed (official site; Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Queues are common and food takes time, so allow extra (2026 reviews). 22 seats: a counter of 4, tables for 8, and a private tatami room for about 10 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). About 10 min on foot from Nijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 24 March 2012 (Tabelog).
kyoto_shinrin_shokudo.notes: [Curry · Nijo, Kyoto's forest of spice curry] A travelling curry caterer that put down roots in 2012, in a house near Nijo whose front is a thicket of plants and whose room is full of greenery, dried flowers and folk craft. The menu changes daily: two or three curries share a long plate with multigrain rice and a crowd of small sides — perhaps pork keema with spinach, a coconut bonito-soup curry, and the house squid-ink duck keema. Expect a queue and a wait for plates that look like artwork. Opening days are irregular (it closes for catering jobs), so check the online calendar first. About ¥2,000–2,500; cash only.

roles: Run by an owner who is not named in the sources (2026 reviews mention "the female owner" and friendly staff)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: "the travelling curry caterer that became a shop", now nearly 14 years as a shop; a list of events from 2006–2010 at galleries and live houses in Kyoto, Osaka, Shiga and Kobe; the concept is to pour the spirit of making things into the spices, the way an artist wrestles with material. Tabelog: opened 24 March 2012; Curry "Tabelog 100" 2017, 2018, 2022 and Curry WEST 2019, 2020, 2023, 2024, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: To make a one-of-a-kind, beloved curry with the maker's spirit poured in with the spices (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Multi-curry plates; squid-ink duck keema.

anecdotes.text: "The interior is surrounded by plants and folk crafts, creating a friendly and calming atmosphere—very nice." — September 2026.
"However, the operating hours are quite irregular. It is essential to check the website for business days and hours before visiting." — September 2026.
"Waiting time melts away with smiles at this forest restaurant." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (shinrin-syokudo.com): 「出張ケータリングカレー、森林食堂が店舗化してもうすぐ14年」、「店舗化しちゃった、出張カレー屋」、アーティストが物質と格闘するようにモノづくり精神をスパイスと共に注ぐ、不定休なのでカレンダーを確認、空欄や営業時間の記載がない日は休み、出張カレーのために閉めることあり、中京区西ノ京内畑町24-4、2006〜2010年のイベント出店。食べログ: カレー、11:30〜14:30・18:00〜20:00、不定休、予約可、22席 (カウンター4、テーブル8、座敷の個室約10名)、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、2012年3月24日オープン、カレー 百名店 2017・2018・2022、カレー WEST 百名店 2019・2020・2023・2024・2026。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 植物に囲まれた店内、日替わりの2〜3種盛り、イカスミの鴨キーマ、行列と待ち時間。

kyoto_velrosier.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the booking page says the restaurant does not offer gluten-free menus; the courses include gyoza and spring-roll wrappers and house noodles of seven kinds of domestic wheat (TableCheck; 2026 reviews). Allergies must be declared at booking; no changes on the day (TableCheck).
kyoto_velrosier.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the booking page says no vegan, vegetarian or pescatarian menus are offered (TableCheck).
kyoto_velrosier.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (enter by 13:00) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (enter by 19:00); closed Wednesday (official site); further closing days are posted each month — November 2026: 3, 4, 11, 12, 18, 25 (Tabelog). Reservation only, online through TableCheck (official site); parties of 9 or more by phone, 075-744-6984 (TableCheck). Same-day cancellation is charged in full (TableCheck). Children only if they can eat the full course seated like adults (TableCheck). Lunch ¥11,000 or ¥20,000, dinner ¥22,000, tax included, plus 10% service; shark-fin courses ¥30,000 (lunch) and ¥32,000 (dinner) (official site; TableCheck). 16 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). GOOD NATURE STATION 2F, 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_velrosier.notes: [Chinese · Kawaramachi, two-star creative Chinese behind a cell-like door] Through a barred, jail-like entrance off a Kawaramachi complex into a dark, sleek room with an open kitchen: owner-chef Yuji Iwasaki, ten years in hotel Chinese kitchens, opened in Ashiya in 2014 and moved here in 2019, and an October 2026 diner notes two Michelin stars since 2023. The chef's "add on" style layers flavours: foie gras monaka with hozuki jam, a gyoza rebuilt as chive custard under chive snow, char siu with fried bonito, almond tofu many call the best they've had. Portions are big. Lunch from ¥11,000 plus 10%; book on TableCheck. No vegetarian or gluten-free menus.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yuji Iwasaki (岩崎祐司; official site: "YUJI IWASAKI")
roles: Owner-chef (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: ten years at a hotel Chinese restaurant, then opened VELROSIER in Ashiya-Kurakuen in 2014 and moved it to Kawaramachi, Kyoto in 2019. An October 2026 review adds that it earned a second Michelin star in 2023, the first Chinese restaurant in Kansai to do so; the Tabelog shop text calls it "Kansai's first Chinese restaurant with two Michelin stars". Tabelog Chinese WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023, 2024, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Add on": building new tastes by combining ingredients, judging their compatibility, components and textures; traditional Chinese cooking seen from a Japanese perspective (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Foie gras monaka; deconstructed gyoza; almond tofu.

anecdotes.text: "The entrance of the restaurant resembles a jail cell, perhaps suggesting that once you enter, you won't want to leave!" — July 2026.
"I think my favorite was the foie gras monaka." — August 2026.
"With baked meringue, chocolate powder, and various textures, this is the most delicious almond tofu I have ever had." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (vel-rosier.com): 岩崎祐司 (YUJI IWASAKI)、10年間ホテルの中華料理店で研鑽した後、2014年に芦屋・苦楽園で VELROSIER を開業、2019年に京都河原町に移転、昼12:00〜15:00 (13:00までに入店)、夜18:00〜22:00 (19:00までに入店)、定休日は毎週水曜日、Dejeuner 11,000円・20,000円、Diner 22,000円 (税込、サービス料10%)、紹興酒・ワイン・中国茶。TableCheck: フカヒレ付きの昼30,000円・夜32,000円、アレルギーは予約時に全員分を明記、当日の変更不可、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・ペスカタリアン・グルテンフリー向けのメニューは提供していない、子どもは大人と同条件で、当日キャンセルは全額。食べログ: 中華・イノベーティブ、GOOD NATURE STATION 2F、16席、車椅子可、中国料理 WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2024・2026。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): ミシュラン二つ星、フォアグラの monaka、「add on」、量が多い。

kyoto_yakitori_kyoto_tachibana.gf_detail: Ask when booking: skewers are salt-grilled, but the course ends with chicken-broth ramen and includes a kombu-cured chicken nigiri (official site; 2026 reviews). The site has no allergy note and asks guests to phone ahead.
kyoto_yakitori_kyoto_tachibana.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken omakase from sashimi to skewers and ramen.
kyoto_yakitori_kyoto_tachibana.hours_raw: From October 2026, two dinner seatings daily (closing time not given; stored to 22:30 as on Tabelog's earlier weekend second seating): 18:00 (full course) and 20:30 (shorter course, irregular, booked gradually; grilled by someone other than head chef Sakata); closed irregularly, posted on Instagram (Tabelog; official site). Reservation only, on TableCheck or by phone 075-741-6666; same-day seats by phone 11:00–15:00 (official site). Cancellation fees from 10 days before (30%, then 50% and 100%); no proxy bookings; no strong perfume; children if they can eat the adult course (official site). 10 counter seats; private hire for 8–10 (official site; Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); service charge 10% (Tabelog). Basement of バインオークAiina, 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (official site). Opened November 2021 (official site).
kyoto_yakitori_kyoto_tachibana.notes: [Yakitori · Kyoto City Hall, Takasaka chicken by a former kaiseki cook] A spotless ten-seat basement counter where owner 坂田知紀, who trained in sushi and kaiseki before falling for Takasaka chicken, grills one long omakase: raw white liver as creamy as cheese, chicken sashimi, nine skewers with crisp skin and moist meat, a kombu-cured breast nigiri and a finish of chicken ramen. A smokeless grill keeps your clothes clean. Diners call the chef warm; one was seen off at the door. Two seatings, 18:00 and a shorter 20:30. ¥16,500 plus 10% service; book on TableCheck.

chef_bio.chef_name: 坂田知紀 (official site: "店主 坂田 知紀"; reviews give the surname as Sakata; no romaji for the given name)
roles: Owner-chef, at the grill (official site; October 2026 review: "Grill Master: Sakata")
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: trained for years in sushi and kaiseki restaurants before turning to yakitori after falling for Takasaka chicken; opened in Nakagyo-ku in November 2021; Tabelog Yakitori WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023–2025; Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2025 selected restaurant. A September 2026 diner reports the grill is smokeless so guests can wear nice clothes.
chef_bio.specialty: Takasaka chicken skewers; white liver; chicken ramen.

anecdotes.text: "On the way out, the owner kindly saw us off, making for a heartwarming experience." — August 2026.
"They use a smoke-free grill because they want women to feel comfortable wearing nice clothes." — September 2026.
"The first surprise was the white liver sashimi. It was incredibly creamy!" — October 2026.

kyoto_mirei.gf_detail: Ask. Dishes are ordered one by one from about 50, so sashimi, grilled fish or a dobin-mushi can be chosen; fried dishes and handmade soba are also on the menu (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_mirei.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Kyoto kappo built on dashi and fish; vegetable dishes such as dashi-simmered ones use dashi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_mirei.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30), two seatings: 17:00–19:00 and 19:30 to closing; closed Wednesday and about one other day a month (Tabelog). Reservation only, by phone 075-251-2007 (Tabelog); a September 2026 diner found bookings relatively easy. Counter only, 9 seats; no lunch, no private room (Tabelog). Guests 20 and over at the counter; no very casual clothes (Tabelog). Charge ¥4,000 before tax, including the appetiser (Tabelog). Same-day cancellation fee ¥10,000 (à la carte) or ¥20,000 (course); a no-show after 20 minutes is cancelled (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 3 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 8 May 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_mirei.notes: [Kappo · Marutamachi, kaiseki-grade cooking à la carte] A nine-seat counter in a quiet townhouse where you build your own meal from some fifty dishes on an artfully written menu — a little sashimi, a dobin-mushi of Matsutake and sweet sea bream in autumn, a fried horse mackerel, handmade soba to finish — in half portions if you like. Chef Yuuzou Nakao cooks with a small team; diners call the chef young, unpretentious and easy to talk to. Book by phone for one of two seatings (17:00 or 19:30); a ¥4,000 charge covers the opening dishes, and most spend ¥20,000–30,000. Adults only.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yuuzou Nakao (Tabelog shop page; no kanji in a source)
roles: Head chef (Tabelog shop page; January 2026 review: "The head chef is quite young")
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog page: about 50 à la carte dishes a day, because the chef believes customers can enjoy dishes that match the day's mood in the portions they want, and it is easy to order sashimi or a grilled dish late with a drink; classical and modern Kyoto cooking; a room inspired by the simplicity of Millet's paintings. Opened 8 May 2016; lunch and private-room service ended; Tabelog Award 2022 Bronze; Japanese cuisine WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Let guests choose dishes for the day's mood, in the amount they want (Tabelog shop page).
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte Kyoto kappo; fried sweet sea bream; handmade soba.

anecdotes.text: "The head chef is quite young and, in a good way, lacks the typical “head chef” demeanor, making him easy to talk to." — January 2026.
"Orders at each table are varied, but the appetizers are served first, so it’s best to arrive on time for your reservation." — June 2026, a tenth visit.
"The chef's unpretentious service adds to the comfortable atmosphere." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 実伶、日本料理、中京区竹屋町通室町東入亀屋町143-2、丸太町駅から徒歩約3分、17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、2部制 (17:00〜19:00、19:30〜)、水曜と月1回ほど休み、予約のみ、カウンター9席のみ、昼の予約と個室は終了、チャージ (先付込み) 4,000円税別、当日キャンセルは一品料理10,000円・コース20,000円、20分連絡がなければキャンセル扱い、カウンターは20歳以上、ラフすぎる服装は不可、2016年5月8日オープン、The Tabelog Award 2022 Bronze、日本料理 WEST 百名店 2021、毎日約50品の一品料理、料理長 Yuuzou Nakao。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): 好きなものを好きなだけ、Matsutake の dobin-mushi、手打ちの soba、若く気さくな料理長、2部制。

cultural_comfort.note: A menu of about 50 dishes ordered one by one; booking by phone.

existence.note: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_demachi_futaba.gf_detail: Ask. Rice-cake sweets (mochi with red peas, black soybeans or chestnuts, dusted with rice flour) and red rice, but no ingredient list is published; the Mont Blanc has a chestnut paste and other items vary (2026 reviews).
kyoto_demachi_futaba.vegan_detail: Ask. Bean-paste rice cakes and red rice; no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_demachi_futaba.hours_raw: 8:30–17:30; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). October 2026 reviewers report the shutters opening at 8:00. Takeaway only; sweets are to be eaten the same day (Tabelog). Long queues, often stretching across the street; some items can be reserved by phone (075-231-1658) and collected without queuing, e.g. black-bean daifuku and chestnut mochi a week ahead, but the autumn chestnut Mont Blanc cannot be reserved and sells out early, with a limit of three per person (2025–2026 reviews). Cash only (Tabelog). 7 min from Demachiyanagi Stn across the Kawai and Demachi bridges (Tabelog).
kyoto_demachi_futaba.notes: [Sweets · Demachi, Kyoto's mame mochi queue] A takeaway counter by the Demachi bridges where the line regularly runs across Kawaramachi-dori for the famous mame mochi: soft rice cake studded with salty red peas around smooth bean paste, about ¥290. In autumn come chestnut mochi with two whole chestnuts, black-bean daifuku, chestnut red rice and a chestnut Mont Blanc that sells out soon after opening. Eat everything the same day, ideally on the Kamo riverbank a minute away. Some items can be reserved by phone to skip the queue. Cash only; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Shop staff; no person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022 and Japanese sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023, 2026 (Tabelog). 2026 reviewers describe longer queues each year, mostly of visitors.
chef_bio.specialty: Mame mochi; autumn chestnut sweets.

anecdotes.text: "As always, there was an incredible line, and I was really glad I made a reservation!" — October 2026, an eleventh visit.
"I arrived at the store at 7:00. There were already about 15 people in line." — October 2026, for the Mont Blanc.
"I did get to enjoy one bean rice cake right away, and it was definitely the best I've ever had!" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 出町ふたば、和菓子・大福、上京区出町通今出川上ル青龍町236、出町柳駅から徒歩7分、月・木〜日 8:30〜17:30、火・水休み、持ち帰りのみ、消費期限は当日、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018・2019・2020・2022、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 名物の mame mochi、kuri mochi、kuromame daifuku、栗のモンブランの早朝の行列、電話で予約できる品も。

cultural_comfort.note: Point and buy at the counter; queue, or reserve some items by phone.

kyoto_assemblages_kakimoto.gf_detail: Ask. Mostly wheat-based cakes, pies and baked goods; chocolates and plated desserts may differ, but no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_assemblages_kakimoto.vegan_detail: Ask. Cakes and plated desserts use cream, cheese and mousse (2026 reviews).
kyoto_assemblages_kakimoto.hours_raw: Shop 12:00–19:00 and café 12:00–17:00, Mon and Thu–Sun; dinner from 18:00 by reservation only; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). The official site gives takeaway 12:00–19:00, eat-in from 12:00, dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 20:00) at ¥15,800 before tax, and closing on Tuesday and the second and fourth Wednesday. Café: choose your cake and pay at the entrance first; a drink alone is not accepted (October 2026 reviews). 10 counter seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR payment (Tabelog). 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 21 April 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_assemblages_kakimoto.notes: [Sweets · Imperial Palace south, the pâtissier-chocolatier-cook's townhouse] Behind a discreet machiya front near Teramachi, a stylish modern counter where the chef — pâtissier, chocolatier and cook in one, per the shop — puts flavours together: the layered "Assemblages" chocolate cake, a Mont Blanc on crisp pastry, and plated desserts such as a chocolate sphere melted at the counter with flaming strawberry brandy. Choose and pay at the door, then take one of ten seats with tea or coffee; chocolates and baked goods go home well. In the evening it serves a dessert-led dinner by reservation. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday; cakes sell out by evening.

chef_bio.chef_name: Kakimoto (垣本; official site: "パティシエ垣本"; no given name in a source read)
roles: Owner, pâtissier, chocolatier and cook (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a chef with three faces — pâtissier, chocolatier and cuisinier — whose "assemblages" of flavours are served with drinks; dinner courses by the pâtissier. Tabelog: opened 21 April 2016; Sweets "Tabelog 100" 2017 and Sweets WEST 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2026. Reviews of the bar Calvador (kyoto_calvador_bar, May 2026) mention Calvados chocolates made with Assemblage Kakimoto.
chef_bio.philosophy: Combining tastes — "assemblages" — to be enjoyed with drinks (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Assemblages cake; plated chocolate desserts.

anecdotes.text: "Blue flames were dancing on the surface of the chocolate sphere!!" — October 2026, the plated Le Jardin.
"It seems that ordering drinks alone isn’t allowed; you must order a drink along with another item." — October 2026.
"This is my number one cake in life" — September 2026.

kyoto_patisserie_s_salon.gf_detail: Ask. French-style cakes and baked goods, mostly with flour; a meringue cake was on sale in 2026, but no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_patisserie_s_salon.vegan_detail: Ask. Cream, fromage blanc and mousse cakes (2026 reviews); no vegan item is mentioned.
kyoto_patisserie_s_salon.hours_raw: 13:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Wednesday and Thursday; may close early once the fresh cakes sell out (official site; Tabelog lists 12:30). 2026 reviewers find the case nearly empty by about 15:00–15:30, and a short queue at opening. No reservations (Tabelog). A few counter seats, tables and a terrace (September 2026 review); order and pay first (October 2026). Cards, e-money and PayPay accepted (Tabelog; September 2026). On Rokkaku-dori, about 10 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (October 2026 review).
kyoto_patisserie_s_salon.notes: [Sweets · Rokkaku-dori, the sit-down branch of Patisserie S] Kyoto's much-loved Patisserie S sells only takeaway at its main shop, so this small antique-styled salon is where you can sit with the cakes: the signature "S", a light fromage blanc cake bright with lemon and grapefruit around red fruit, with an Earl Grey, or a Chocolat Framboise on the little terrace. It opens at 13:00 and the case is often nearly empty by mid-afternoon, so come early. Order and pay at the counter first. Cake and tea around ¥1,500. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Shop staff; no person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: two shops — the main shop at 下京区高辻通室町西入繁昌町300-1 (11:00–19:00) and this salon — both closed Wednesday and Thursday, both closing early when the fresh cakes run out. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2026 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: The "S" cake; seasonal cakes with tea.

anecdotes.text: "I learned that they open at 1 PM and sell out by 3:30 PM." — September 2026.
"The atmosphere has a lovely British vibe." — September 2026.
"They were delicate, light, and perfectly balanced—truly a work of art." — October 2026.

kyoto_gion_fukushi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a kaiseki course with soy- and miso-seasoned dishes, fried items and, at times, a soba course (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_fukushi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dashi-centred kaiseki with fish, quail and beef (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_fukushi.hours_raw: Dinner only, all guests starting together at 18:00 — please arrive by then; closed Sunday and irregularly (Tabelog). No closing time is published, so no hours are stored; a 2025 meal took about three hours. Reservation only, by phone (Tabelog); 100% cancellation charge from five days before (Tabelog, prices changed from 1 October). Seven counter seats; private hire for up to 8 (Tabelog). Children from junior-high age (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); service charge 10% (Tabelog). About 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 December 2017 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_fukushi.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, a seven-seat counter with English-speaking staff] Down a quiet lane off Hanamikoji, a soft, calm counter of seven where owner-chef Takuji Fukushi, from Aomori, serves a dashi-led Kyoto kaiseki on beautiful tableware: clear soups, Akashi sea bream, grilled karasumi and quail, sea bream rice, and matcha whisked at the end. A February 2026 diner notes many overseas guests and staff fluent in English. Everyone starts at 18:00, so be on time; allow about three hours. Around ¥30,000–40,000 a head with service. Book by phone; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.chef_name: Takuji Fukushi (February 2026 review: "The owner, Takuji Fukushi"; no given-name kanji in a source)
roles: Owner-chef
chef_bio.background: Per a February 2026 review: from Aomori; the restaurant attracts international guests and the staff speak fluent English. Earlier reviews (2024–2025) call it Michelin one-starred and note the chef whisking the closing matcha and keeping guests entertained. Tabelog: opened 1 December 2017; Japanese cuisine WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023.
chef_bio.specialty: Dashi-led seasonal kaiseki; sea bream rice.

anecdotes.text: "the staff is fluent in English, providing attentive service that reassures foreign guests" — February 2026.
"One of the few places in Kyoto that serves delicious food." — September 2026.
"To conclude, the chef himself prepared matcha for us, which was truly delightful." — April 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ぎをん 福志、日本料理、東山区祇園町南側570-120、祇園四条駅から徒歩約10分、予約のみ、18:00一斉スタート、日曜と不定休、10月1日から価格改定、キャンセルは5日前から100%、カウンター7席、貸切は8名まで、中学生以上、カード可、サービス料10%、2017年12月1日オープン、日本料理 WEST 百名店 2023。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 店主の Takuji Fukushi さんは Aomori 出身、英語の堪能なスタッフ、器と出汁、海外からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: A February 2026 diner reports staff fluent in English and many overseas guests.

kyoto_korisu.gf_detail: Ask. Much of the menu is breaded, battered or in béchamel (gratin, fries, cutlets, hamburg steak with demi-glace), but there are risottos, salads and grilled beef tagliata (2026 reviews).
kyoto_korisu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat, seafood and cheese menu; even the salad carries ham and egg (2026 reviews).
kyoto_korisu.hours_raw: 11:30–19:00; closed Tuesday, and every year from 25 January to 25 February (Tabelog). Reservations open at the end of each month for the following month, by phone (Tabelog); 2026 diners describe calling from 8:00 and getting through after hundreds of attempts (October 2026), so the booking route is persistence by phone, 075-561-9281. À la carte, best shared among 4–5 (September 2026). 12 seats at tables; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). Bringing wine generally not allowed except by arrangement for celebrations (Tabelog). On Matsubara-dori, about 7–9 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (2026 reviews).
kyoto_korisu.notes: [Yoshoku · Matsubara-dori, Kyoto's hardest Western table] In a brown-brick house near Rokuharamitsu-ji, a dozen seats where a family carries on a couple's yoshoku: a bubbling macaroni gratin, a round hamburg steak beside a crisp fry, pumpkin soup so thick the spoon stands in it, a famous clubhouse sandwich and tiramisu. Portions are generous, so come as four or five and share. Getting in is the hard part: bookings open by phone at the end of each month for the next, and 2026 diners report hundreds of calls. Around ¥5,000–8,000 a head; cash only; closed Tuesdays and from late January to late February.

roles: Family-run: once a couple, now "a mother and her daughters" in chef's whites (September 2026 review); no names in a source
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a long-established yoshoku restaurant carried on from the previous generation; Michelin Bib Gourmand, per an October 2026 review; now reservation-only and among the hardest tables in Kyoto to book. Tabelog Yoshoku "Tabelog 100" 2020, 2023 and Yoshoku WEST 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Macaroni gratin; hamburg steak with a fry; pumpkin soup.

anecdotes.text: "Originally run by a couple, the restaurant is now managed by a mother and her daughters." — September 2026.
"After calling about 500 times, I finally managed to get through and make a reservation." — October 2026.
"this soup was so thick that the spoon left a mark, almost like a firm custard." — October 2026, the pumpkin soup.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: コリス、洋食、東山区松原通大和大路東入2丁目轆轤町101、清水道バス停から徒歩3分、月・水〜日 11:30〜19:00、火曜休み、毎年1月25日〜2月25日休業、予約は前月末から翌月分、12席、貸切20名まで、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、ワインの持ち込みは原則不可、ソムリエあり、洋食百名店 2020・2023、洋食 WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年7〜11月、英語): 先代から続く味、母と娘たち、マカロニグラタン、ハンバーグとフライ、かぼちゃのスープ、電話がつながらない予約。

cultural_comfort.note: Bookings only by phone, opening at the end of each month and very hard to get through; a Japanese speaker or hotel concierge helps.

kyoto_kokyu_demachi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a seasonal kaiseki with soy-seasoned dishes and sushi (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kokyu_demachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dashi-based kaiseki with fish, beef and duck (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kokyu_demachi.hours_raw: Lunch starts at 12:00 and dinner at 18:00, everyone together; closed Monday and occasionally other days (official site; Tabelog). No closing times are published, so no hours are stored. Reservation only, by phone (075-746-4375; easiest 9:00–11:00, 14:30–17:30, 20:30–23:00) by the day before, or online via TableCheck; guests from abroad are asked to book through their hotel (official site). Cancellation 50% the day before, 100% on the day; no strong perfume; children under 10 in the private room only; non-smoking (official site). 9 counter seats and one private room for up to 6 (official site). Cash only (Tabelog). 5 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (official site). Opened 21 October 2015 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kokyu_demachi.notes: [Kaiseki · Demachi, a Sakurada-trained counter where the rivers meet] Near the confluence of the Kamo and Takano rivers, a clean, quiet nine-seat counter where owner-chef Sho Maeda, ten years at the celebrated kaiseki house Sakurada, cooks one course that tells the season in taste, presentation and tableware — Japanese ceramics alongside French plates — and explains every dish as it comes. A September 2026 Matsutake menu brought mackerel and fig on a bowl of ice and anago draped over a full-moon tofu. A March 2025 diner was welcomed by the couple who run it. Reservation only and hard to get; overseas guests should book through their hotel. Lunch around ¥16,500; cash only.

chef_bio.chef_name: Sho Maeda (February 2026 review; no kanji in a source)
roles: Owner-chef
chef_bio.background: Per a February 2026 review: trained for ten years, from the twenties, at the renowned kaiseki restaurant Sakurada (桜田) and went independent two or three years before it closed. Per the official site: seasonal Kyoto cooking that lets guests feel the season and Japanese culture, in a calm spot near Shimogamo Shrine and the Imperial Palace Park. A March 2025 diner was welcomed by "the couple running the restaurant". Tabelog: opened 21 October 2015; Japanese cuisine WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: Each dish and its arrangement has a meaning: seasonal ingredients, much handwork, and the seasons and Japanese culture made visible (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; hassun with flowers.

anecdotes.text: "The owner, Sho Maeda, trained for 10 years at the renowned kaiseki restaurant “Sakurada” since his twenties." — February 2026.
"Watching the chef fillet the eel right in front of me was a delightful experience" — September 2026.
"The couple running the restaurant made me feel very welcomed." — March 2025.

kyoto_koke_ido.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the course starts with a broth of island-pork cheek and kombu and uses fish throughout (August 2026 review).
kyoto_koke_ido.hours_raw: Dinner Tue–Thu; lunch and dinner Fri–Sat; lunch Sunday; closed Monday (official site). Lunch seatings 12:00 or 12:30, closing 14:30; dinner seatings 18:00 or 18:30 (official site); Tabelog gives dinner to 22:00. Reservation only, online or by phone 12:00–17:00 (Tabelog). Lunch ¥15,000, dinner ¥29,000, tax included, plus 15% service and fuel charge (official site; Tabelog); an alcohol or non-alcohol pairing brought one August 2026 dinner to ¥45,000. No children under 12; smart casual (Tabelog). 12 seats: a counter of 6 and two tables of up to 4 (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). IDO KYOTO 1F, 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog). Opened 14 April 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_koke_ido.notes: [Innovative · Karasuma-Oike, Okinawa meets Spain by a moss garden] On the ground floor of IDO KYOTO, a calm, stylish room facing a moss garden, where owner-chef 中村有作 (Yusaku Nakamura), from Okinawa and trained at Ca Sento in Kobe, cooks over firewood and charcoal with water drawn from the garden well. Over about twenty dishes, Okinawan ingredients and island classics are rebuilt with Spanish technique — jimami tofu, sukugarasu on kombu cookies, a broth of island-pork cheek. Madame Sachiko's non-alcoholic pairing is a highlight. English is spoken. Dinner ¥29,000 plus 15%; lunch ¥15,000 from Friday to Sunday. Book ahead; no children under 12.

chef_bio.chef_name: 中村有作 (Yusaku Nakamura; kanji from the official site, romaji from 2026 reviews)
roles: Owner-chef (official site; October 2026 review)
Madame 中村瑳智子 (Sachiko), non-alcoholic pairings (official site; August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a message from 福本伸也 of Ca Sento (カセント) announcing that 中村有作 would open independently in Kyoto after training there, joined by sommelier 大山達也; KOKE sits on the ground floor of IDO KYOTO, whose shops use spring water drawn from the garden well. Per 2026 reviews: trained at Edition Koji Shimomura in Tokyo and for a long time at Ca Sento; in recent years the menu has turned much more Okinawan; Madame Sachiko, who worked with the chef at Malta in Chofu, creates the non-alcoholic pairings and launched the brand "nona". Tabelog: opened 14 April 2021; Innovative "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Hospitality born from water: spring water from the garden well and cooking that values the essentials (IDO KYOTO official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Okinawan-Spanish tasting course; non-alcoholic pairing.

anecdotes.text: "This is what happens when Spanish cuisine fuses with Okinawan court cuisine" — May 2026.
"Few places in Japan offer such well-crafted pairings made in-house, which is impressive." — September 2026.
"Dinner consists of 20 dishes for JPY 29,000." — August 2026.

kyoto_les_champs_dor.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Classic French with butter and cream sauces, bread and pastry desserts such as savarin (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_les_champs_dor.vegan_detail: Not vegan: classic French courses of seafood, foie gras, duck and lamb (official site).
kyoto_les_champs_dor.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last entry 13:30) Tue–Sat; dinner 18:00–22:00 (last entry 19:00) Tue, Thu and Sat only, since 2022; closed Sunday and Monday, with seasonal breaks in January and August; year-end: Christmas menus 19–25 December 2026, open to lunch on 25 December, reopening with lunch on 6 January (official site). Book by phone (075-255-2277) during opening hours, or online on Ikyu (official site). Lunch ¥6,655 or ¥7,865, special course "天上の晩餐" ¥21,780 at lunch or dinner, tax and service included (official site). 24 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 10 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). Founded 1983 (official site).
kyoto_les_champs_dor.notes: [French · Central Kyoto, a 1983 classic in new hands] A calm, old-school French dining room near Rokkaku that has served butter-and-cream classics since 1983 — snow crab in jelly, lobster bisque, roast duck with foie gras and fig, savarin to finish — with a well-priced cellar of Bordeaux, Burgundy and grower Champagne. Founding chef 田島福廣 retired in March 2026, and 熊﨑隆一・香 took over in April, keeping the classic style. Lunch is the popular choice, from ¥6,655 with tax and service; dinner only on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday. Book by phone or Ikyu. Tabelog's English page calls it "Les Chandelles"; the shop's own name is Les Champs d'Or.

chef_bio.chef_name: 熊﨑隆一・香 (owners since April 2026; official site; no romaji in a source)
roles: Owners since April 2026 (official site)
Founded in 1983 by chef 田島福廣 and manager 奥田孝雄 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the name means "golden fields", a land at harvest; founded in 1983 by chef 田島福廣 and manager 奥田孝雄, serving orthodox French cooking for over forty years; taken over from April 2026 by 熊﨑隆一・香. A March 2026 review marks Chef Tajima's retirement at the end of that month. Tabelog Award Bronze 2021–2025; French WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023, 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Orthodox French cooking that brings out the ingredients, firm in flavour, with delicacy and dignity (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Classic French; snow crab jelly; roast duck.

anecdotes.text: "As I was leaving, Chef Tajima came out to greet us, and I even asked for a commemorative photo." — March 2026, before the chef's retirement.
"In a world where innovative and fusion cuisines dominate, it was refreshing to savor traditional French dishes once again." — November 2025.
"The interior is sophisticated, and the atmosphere of a high-end French restaurant from the Showa era is quite nostalgic!" — January 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (leschampsdor.jp): レ・シャンドール (Les Champs d'Or)、「黄金の畑」、chef 田島福廣と manager 奥田孝雄が1983年に創業、2026年4月より熊﨑隆一・香が引き継ぐ、正統派フランス料理、中京区柳馬場蛸薬師上る419、昼12:00〜15:00 (最終入店13:30)、夜18:00〜22:00 (最終入店19:00) 火・木・土のみ (2022年から)、日・月定休、1月・8月に季節休暇、ランチ A 6,655円・B 7,865円、特別コース「天上の晩餐」21,780円 (税・サ込)、秋のメニュー、電話と一休で予約、オンラインショップ (焼き菓子、鴨ロース、デリカセット2027)。食べログ: フレンチ、柳馬場通六角下ル井筒屋419、24席、カード可、The Tabelog Award Bronze 2021〜2025、フレンチ WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2025。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 古典的なフランス料理、Tajima シェフの引退、昭和の高級フレンチの雰囲気、ワイン。

kyoto_kagizen_yoshifusa_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. The famous kuzukiri is made from kudzu starch and served with black or white syrup, and warabi mochi comes in kinako; other sweets vary and no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kagizen_yoshifusa_shijo.vegan_detail: Ask. Kuzukiri with syrup, warabi mochi and bean-paste sweets; no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kagizen_yoshifusa_shijo.hours_raw: Shop 9:30–18:00; tea room 10:00–18:00 (last order 17:30, earlier when busy); closed Monday, or Tuesday when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog). The official site says its November and December 2026 hours are unchanged. No reservations for the tea room (Tabelog); expect a queue at weekends and peak times, and shared large tables when busy (October 2026 reviews). 62 seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking; wheelchair access (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), WAON and PayPay (Tabelog). On Shijo-dori, 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kagizen_yoshifusa_shijo.notes: [Sweets · Gion, the Edo-era kuzukiri house on Shijo-dori] A confectioner that has stood by the approach to Yasaka Shrine since the mid-Edo period. Past the showcase of wagashi is a calm tea room facing a small courtyard, where the house kuzukiri arrives in a two-tier box: glossy kudzu noodles made to order, floating in iced water, to dip in dark kuromitsu or white syrup — light, cool and slippery. Warabi mochi in deep kinako and matcha are the other draws; Kagimochi makes a good gift. No reservations, so expect a short queue at weekends. Around ¥1,600 for kuzukiri. Closed Mondays.

roles: Long-established confectioner; no person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: since the mid-Edo period, Kagizen Yoshifusa has walked with Gion beside the gate of Yasaka Shrine; the Shijo honten and the 高台寺店 serve the famous kuzukiri, keeping an Edo tradition, and seasonal wagashi; the company also runs ZEN CAFE and the ZENBI art museum with its shop. Tabelog Sweets "Tabelog 100" 2017, Sweets WEST 2018–2020, 2022 and Japanese sweets WEST 2023, 2026 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kuzukiri; Kagimochi.

anecdotes.text: "The kuzukiri (starch noodles) were light and delicious, especially when dipped in the rich black syrup, making them smooth and slippery." — October 2026.
"When asked if I wanted black syrup or white syrup, I inquired, “Which one is better?” and was told, “If you like sweet things, black syrup is sweeter.”" — October 2026.
"On a weekday at 12:15, there was no line." — October 2026; by 12:45 about 15 people were waiting.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kagizen.co.jp): 江戸中期より八坂神社の門前で祇園とともに歩んできた鍵善良房、四条本店や高台寺店では江戸の伝統を守る名物「くずきり」と四季の和菓子、ZEN CAFE、ZENBI 鍵善良房 KAGIZEN ART MUSEUM、ミュージアムショップ Zplus、11月・12月の営業時間に変更なし (2026年10月のお知らせ)。食べログ: 甘味処・和菓子・カフェ、東山区祇園町北側264、菓子販売9:30〜18:00、喫茶10:00〜18:00 (L.O.17:30)、月曜定休 (祝日の場合は翌日)、喫茶は予約不可、62席、カード・WAON・PayPay 可、スイーツ百名店 2017、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018〜2020・2022、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。口コミ (2026年10〜11月、英語): くずきり、黒蜜と白蜜、わらび餅、抹茶、Kagimochi、週末の行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue, then order kuzukiri (black or white syrup) at the table; no reservations.

kyoto_grains_de_vanille.gf_detail: Ask. French cakes, pastries and breads, mostly with flour; mousses and a meringue cake are on sale but no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_grains_de_vanille.vegan_detail: Ask. Cream, mousse and butter pastries; many cakes contain alcohol, and staff check this at the counter (2026 reviews).
kyoto_grains_de_vanille.hours_raw: 10:30–18:00, café last order 16:30; closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog); the official site points to Instagram and Facebook for closing days. Cakes sell out through the afternoon (September 2026). Choose at the showcase, pay first, then say takeaway or eat-in (October 2026 reviews). Reservations for cakes in person only, not by phone (Tabelog). 18 seats at tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). 4 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn exit 1 (Tabelog). Opened 6 February 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_grains_de_vanille.notes: [Sweets · Karasuma-Oike, Kyoto's patisserie of small, layered cakes] In a narrow lane near Karasuma-Oike, a clean, modern shop whose glass case holds about twenty petite French cakes, many with a touch of alcohol: Marron et Passion, a meringue-and-kirsch Groseille, a Mont Blanc piped to order. Pick at the case, pay, then take a table in the eat-in room with a window onto the kitchen; croissants and breads go home well. Cakes around ¥880; cash only. Closed Sunday and Monday, and the case thins out by late afternoon. An October 2026 regular, who rates the cakes the best in Kyoto, reported hurried, irritable service at the register and showcase, and on two visits saw the owner scold employees loudly enough to be heard across the shop.

roles: Owner-pâtissier; not named in the sources read
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the name means "vanilla seeds" in French, chosen to evoke a sweet shop; no fixed concept, but a sense of the season, made for the customer's "that was delicious". An October 2026 review says the shop has ties to the pâtissier Idemi Sugino. Tabelog Sweets "Tabelog 100" 2017, Sweets WEST 2018–2020, 2022, 2023, 2026; opened 6 February 2011, eat-in from 1 April 2011 (Tabelog). An October 2026 regular reports hurried, irritable service at the register and showcase and, on two visits, the owner reprimanding employees in a harsh tone heard throughout the store.
chef_bio.philosophy: No set concept: seasonality, and a customer's "that was delicious" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Petite French cakes; Mont Blanc.

anecdotes.text: "The French pastries are all petite, yet each one features multiple layers of flavors that are delicate and made with high-quality ingredients" — October 2026.
"The staff often ask, “Is it okay that it contains alcohol?” when customers choose cakes from the showcase" — October 2026.

"Personally, I consider this shop to be the highest-rated among Kyoto’s patisseries." — October 2026, a regular who also reported hurried service and, on two visits, the owner scolding employees in front of customers.

kyoto_dodici.gf_detail: Ask when booking: courses include house-made tagliatelle and other pasta, bread and fried dishes; allergies must be stated precisely when booking, no changes on the day, and some bookings may be declined if the restrictions are many (official site).
kyoto_dodici.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses of fish, eel, Omi beef, pork and venison (official site).
kyoto_dodici.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last entry 13:00) and dinner from 18:00 (last entry 19:00), Tue–Sat and public holidays; closed Sunday and Monday (official site; Tabelog). Dinner closing: Tabelog says 22:00; the official site footer says 20:00. Reservation only, online or by phone, by the day before (official site); a 17:30 start can be arranged (official site). All-omakase: lunch ¥11,000 (8 dishes), dinner ¥19,800 (10 dishes), tax included, plus 10% service; the menu changes monthly (official site). About 500 wines and a pairing by the manager-sommelier (official site). 20 seats, private rooms for 2–8 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 12 December 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_dodici.notes: [Italian · City Hall, a monthly-changing omakase in a luxe townhouse] Opposite the small shrine 白山神社, guests start with cold-brewed hojicha in a garden-view lounge before going up to a high-ceilinged dining room in gold, silver and navy. Head chef 尾本寛, who has cooked Italian food for over thirty years and went to Italy at 28, sends out a course that changes every month with Kyoto vegetables, venison, Omi beef and charcoal-grilled eel; manager 中島丈晶, a sommelier certified in two countries, pairs from about 500 wines. 2026 reviewers call it Michelin-starred. Lunch ¥11,000, dinner ¥19,800, plus 10%; book by the day before.

chef_bio.chef_name: 尾本寛 (head chef; official site; no romaji in a source)
roles: Head chef (official site: "料理長 尾本寛")
Manager and sommelier 中島丈晶 (official site: JSA and AIS certified)

Tabelog: opened 12 December 2020; Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.

Cash only (Tabelog). Parking in front (Tabelog). 4 min from the Hyakumanben bus stop, 7 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_mangetsu_ajari_mochi_honten.notes: [Sweets · Hyakumanben, the home of 阿闍梨餅] The main shop of the confectioner behind one of Kyoto's best-known gifts, the 阿闍梨餅: a soft, chewy round of skin wrapped around just-sweet red bean paste. It is sold at Kyoto Station and department stores, but here you can ask for one warm and freshly made and eat it on a bench, which 2026 visitors say is chewier and better. A pack of five is about ¥700 and keeps five days. Open daily 9:00–18:00 (some Wednesdays closed), closing early when sold out; cash only.

roles: Long-established confectioner; no person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 阿闍梨餅本舗 京菓子司 満月, making the registered 京銘菓 阿闍梨餅, 蜜漬京納言, 京銘菓最中 and 眞菓満月. 2026 reviews describe a shop dating from the late Edo period and the 阿闍梨餅 as created in Taisho 12 (1923) in honour of the monks of Mount Hiei; the sweets are also sold at Kyoto department stores. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2018–2020, 2022 and Japanese sweets WEST 2023, 2026 (Tabelog).

kyoto_daigokuden_rokkaku.gf_detail: Ask. The signature Kohaku Nagashi is agar jelly with a monthly syrup, and warabi mochi comes with kinako and syrup, but toppings change and no ingredient list is published; the shop is also known for castella (2026 reviews).
kyoto_daigokuden_rokkaku.vegan_detail: Ask. Agar, syrups, warabi mochi and bean-paste zenzai; monthly toppings vary (Tabelog lists a white-miso and a honey syrup among them) and no ingredient list is published.
kyoto_daigokuden_rokkaku.hours_raw: 10:00–18:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No reservations; when full, write your name for the waiting list (Tabelog); a 30-minute wait on a holiday lunchtime (September 2026). 22 seats: 16 at tables, 6 on tatami (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB) (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). On Rokkaku-dori, 5 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_daigokuden_rokkaku.notes: [Sweets · Rokkaku-dori, the monthly Kohaku Nagashi] Behind a confectioner's shopfront in a late-Edo townhouse — the house dates from 1885 and is credited with bringing castella to Kyoto — a quiet tea room looks onto a small garden. People come for the Kohaku Nagashi: trembling, glass-clear agar under a syrup that changes each month, grape in September, chestnut zenzai in October, persimmon in November. The warabi mochi is so soft it barely holds on the chopsticks. Write your name on the list when it is full; holiday waits run about half an hour. Around ¥1,000; cards accepted; closed Wednesdays.

roles: Long-established confectioner; no person is named in the sources

kyoto_hosen_kyoto_station.gf_detail: Ask. Azuki-bean and chestnut sweets: zenzai with grilled mochi, chestnut kinton made only from Tanba chestnuts and trehalose (October 2026); no full ingredient list is published.

Inside the Shinkansen ticket gates on the 2F Hachijo-side concourse, so only Shinkansen passengers can reach it (Tabelog; October 2026). No reservations (Tabelog). 30 seats at tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, transport IC cards and QR payment (Tabelog). Staff ask whether you are in a hurry for your train (October 2026).
kyoto_hosen_kyoto_station.notes: [Sweets · Kyoto Station, an azuki tea room inside the Shinkansen gates] The station outlet of Housendo, the Shimogamo bean specialist whose owner travels to Tanba every year for the best black soybeans and dainagon azuki. Behind the souvenir counter is a tea room dressed in Kyoto style, calm despite the crowds: a bowl of dainagon or white-azuki zenzai with grilled mochi, chestnut kinton with matcha in autumn, or a matcha float. Staff check whether you are in a hurry for your train. It is inside the Shinkansen gates, so only for travellers holding a Shinkansen ticket. Zenzai about ¥1,400; open daily.

roles: Housendo outlet; the owner is not named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Housendo (あずき処 宝泉堂) makes its sweets in Shimogamo; the owner goes to the growing areas each year to secure the best Tanba black soybeans and Tanba dainagon azuki, and the sweets are made without preservatives or unnecessary additives; its outlets are the 本店, the tea house 茶寮 宝泉, this station shop (renovated in summer 2020, inside the Shinkansen gates) and 下鴨神社 さるや. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2018–2020, 2022 and Japanese sweets WEST 2023, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Care in every single bean: drawing out the flavour of the best Tanba beans without preservatives (official site).

kyoto_gion_suetomo.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Tabelog lists gluten-free options, and the official site says dishes are changed for allergies, religious reasons or dislikes; the standard kaiseki uses soy sauce and miso (official site; Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_suetomo.vegan_detail: A course with no animal ingredients is offered for vegan guests — request it when booking (official site). The standard kaiseki is built on dashi and fish.
kyoto_gion_suetomo.hours_raw: Lunch with entry 12:00–13:00 and dinner with entry 17:00–19:30; closed irregularly, open through the New Year (official site); Tabelog gives 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:30. Reservation only, by the day before, by phone (075-496-8799), Ikyu or Tabelog (official site). Cancellation 100% on the day or the day before (official site). Lunch: 八坂懐石 ¥12,100 or kaiseki ¥36,300 / ¥72,600; dinner: kaiseki ¥36,300 / ¥72,600, and from 7 November to 20 March a crab omakase ¥60,500 / ¥72,600 (official site); no service charge (Tabelog). 8 counter seats and 4 private rooms, about 33 seats in all (official site; Tabelog). Foreign-language menus (official site). Maiko entertainment by reservation (official site). Non-smoking (official site). Cards incl. UnionPay; Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). By taxi, ask for Kenninji's south gate on Yasaka-dori (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_suetomo.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, a sukiya house facing Kenninji] At the foot of Yasaka-dori, opposite Kenninji's south gate, owner-chef Hisashi Suetomo (末友久史) — trained at a famous ryotei and first head chef of a Gion restaurant — opened in 2009 in a sukiya-style house the owner designed, with a tatami counter, a detached eight-mat room and an upstairs room looking onto the temple. Monthly kaiseki is cooked with deep-well "Yasaka water", the grilled course finished in front of you. Unusually, a fully plant-based course can be arranged, and maiko can be booked to entertain. Lunch from ¥12,100, kaiseki ¥36,300; book by the day before. Reviewers in 2026 range from rapt to lukewarm on value.

chef_bio.chef_name: Hisashi Suetomo (末友久史; official site: "主人 末友久史 Hisashi Suetomo")
roles: Owner-chef (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: trained at famous ryotei and became the first head chef of a Gion restaurant; after leaving, prepared for over a year and opened Gion Suetomo, named for the owner, in 2009, in a building designed to Japanese aesthetics, seeing "the house as part of the cuisine"; renovated at ten years to four private rooms; cooks with "Yasaka water" from 40 m underground; sources produce by visiting farms; the spirit of the tea ceremony's 和敬清寂; open through the New Year. Tabelog: opened 11 February 2009; Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2022; Japanese cuisine WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Gentle on the body and gentle on the heart"; conveying good Japanese culture that is being lost (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly kaiseki; grilled course at the table; vegan course.

anecdotes.text: "The red ume paste in the center enhances the umami of the Yasaka water and dashi." — April 2026.

"The atmosphere of the restaurant and the room was excellent, but the food was just average." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gionsuetomo.kyoto): 祇園 末友、名料亭で腕を磨いた末友久史が2009年にオープン、「構えも料理の一つ」、自ら設計した数寄屋造り、地下40mから汲み上げる「八坂の水」、季語の先付と京文化の八寸の全8品の懐石、個室でも目の前で焼く焼物、和敬清寂、10周年の改装で個室4部屋、舞妓さんとのお座敷遊び (要予約)、アレルギーや宗教上の理由で料理を変更、ヴィーガン向けの動物性食材を使わないコース、外国語メニュー、昼は八坂懐石12,100円・懐石36,300円・72,600円、夜は懐石36,300円・72,600円、季節料理〜蟹〜 (11月7日〜3月20日) 60,500円・72,600円、前日までに予約、昼12:00〜13:00入店、夜17:00〜19:30入店、不定休、キャンセルは前日・当日100%、全面禁煙、大和大路四条下る四丁目 小松町151-73 建仁寺南門前。食べログ: 日本料理・寿司、33席、チャージなし、グルテンフリー・ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン対応、2009年2月11日オープン、The Tabelog Award Bronze 2017〜2022、日本料理 WEST 百名店 2021。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 八坂の水の白粥、祇園祭の八寸、評価の分かれる値ごろ感。

Reservations accepted and recommended for the 11 seats (a counter of 7 and one table for 4); phone 14:30–17:00 (Tabelog); online booking was used for lunch in 2026 (August 2026). No table charge (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). Children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). 1 min from the Umamachi bus stop; about 10 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 20 March 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_private_kitchen_sumiyoshi.notes: [Chinese · Higashiyama, a hideaway counter by the National Museum] A stylish, dim, jazz-playing room of eleven seats just north of the Kyoto National Museum, serving Chinese food with a Kyoto touch. Lunch is the bargain: for ¥2,500, a bang bang chicken salad with seared sea bream and jellyfish that one diner called the best ever, xiaolongbao and shrimp dumplings, and a fiery Sichuan mapo tofu. Dinner courses run to shark fin, Peking duck and a Chinese-style sea bream sashimi (the Seiryu course, ¥10,000). Small and popular, so book. In October 2026 one diner liked the food but found the mostly part-time floor staff left dishes unexplained and plates uncleared. Closed Tuesdays.

kyoto_yi_pan_tsai_tanaka.notes: [Chinese · Mototanaka, a ten-seat Cantonese course counter] In a little enclave of Chinese restaurants by Mototanaka Station on the Eiden line, a chef and madam trained in hotel Chinese kitchens run ten seats and one ever-changing six-dish course: a lavish appetiser platter, Jinhua-ham soups, dried abalone with shark fin, Matsutake xiaolongbao, Shanghai-crab spring rolls. Regulars add mapo tofu or hot-and-sour noodles at the end. The course is ¥9,000 before tax at lunch and dinner — good value, so tables go within a minute of opening on TableCheck a month ahead. Closed Wednesdays; check Instagram for days.

kyoto_toriya_hitomi.notes: [Yakitori · Kawabata-Nijo, the hard-to-book binchotan grill] In a roomy old townhouse on Kawabata-dori, owner Tomoki Hitomi grills over Kishu binchotan, skewer by skewer: a five-cut Takasaka chicken omakase, crisp-skinned wings, neck and liver tasted side by side from two breeds, and a Kyoto duck loin. Free refills of cabbage with ponzu come first; onigiri with sansho and chicken soup finish. Diners describe a humble, attentive owner who remembers regulars. Prices are reasonable for the quality, so bookings go fast — phone between 15:00 and 16:45. Cash only; open to 23:00; closed Wednesdays.

kyoto_yakiniku_yamachan.notes: [Yakiniku · Shijo-Karasuma, course yakiniku from a Kyoto restaurant family] A sister of the Kyoto restaurant Tomikoji Yamagishi, run by the founder's brother according to an October 2026 review, serving one omakase yakiniku course at counters split into private pairs. The blackboard shows no prices; most spend ¥5,000–9,000. Cash only; closed Mondays.

Lunch course ¥12,000 and dinner course ¥24,000 including tax and service (Tabelog remarks, undated); a March 2026 dinner with wine pairing came to about ¥36,000. 26 seats: a counter of 10 on the ground floor and two private rooms for up to 8 upstairs (Tabelog). Non-smoking; ashtray outside (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 6 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 20 December 2016 (January 2026 review).
kyoto_vena.notes: [Italian · Marutamachi, Kyoto as an Italian region] In a hundred-year-old townhouse near Karasuma-Marutamachi, chef Daiki Hayakawa, from the Kyoto Italian Il Ghiottone, cooks as if Kyoto were a region of Italy, and sommelier Yoji Ikemoto pairs from a cellar you walk past on the way in. Ten seats at a single-slab counter face a small garden; two private rooms are upstairs. Expect dishes like fried young Lake Biwa ayu with burrata, hairy-crab tagliolini and Omi beef, finished with the "Sun Egg" pudding. 2026 reviewers call it Michelin-starred. Lunch ¥12,000, dinner ¥24,000 all in; book by phone or Pocket Concierge; closed Wednesdays.

kyoto_gion_ichido.notes: [Teppanyaki · Gion, a couple's teppan kaiseki counter] Just off Shijo on Nawate-dori, eight seats face the griddle run by a husband-and-wife team, where owner-chef Seki cooks a long omakase — teppan as kaiseki, a Japanese base with Western touches: Spanish mackerel with caviar, beef tongue in white miso, Matsutake fried noodles, Ise lobster in chili sauce, a tenderloin-and-foie-gras hamburg and garlic rice. Portions are generous; you are asked your appetite at the start. ¥30,000 before tax, more in some seasons, and drinks add up. Book by phone; closed Thursdays.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 一道、鉄板焼き・日本料理・ステーキ、東山区祇園町南側589 ぎをん松本ビル1階、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、四条 Nawate の交差点を下がった東側、月〜水・金〜日 18:00〜22:30、木曜と月1回の不定休、予約のみ、コース30,000円 (税別、季節により最大10,000円増)、カウンター8席、カード可、2011年6月5日オープン、The Tabelog Award 2021 Bronze、ステーキ・鉄板焼き百名店 2022、WEST 2024・2025。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年10月、英語): 店主の Seki シェフ、夫婦で営むカウンター、創作の鉄板懐石、ホタルイカの焼きそば、伊勢海老のチリソース、量が多い。

kyoto_kissa_ashijima.gf_detail: The Sanjo cheesecake is made with rice flour and described as gluten-free (October 2026 review), and Tabelog lists gluten-free options and allergy information; staff ask about allergies when you order (October 2026). Other cakes and the curry are not described — ask.
kyoto_kissa_ashijima.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and tea suit; the cakes are dairy cheesecakes and chocolate cakes, and the curry has meat (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kissa_ashijima.hours_raw: Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri 12:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); Tue 12:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); Sat and Sun 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:30) (official site; Tabelog). No reservations (official site). 20 seats: a counter of 8 and two tables of 6 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Cards, QUICPay, PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog). Decaf available; the only food is curry (Tabelog). Fifth floor of the Bunmeido building at the south-east corner of Sanjo-Kawaramachi; 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (official site; Tabelog). Opened 15 May 2010 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kissa_ashijima.notes: [Kissaten · Sanjo-Kawaramachi, a calm coffee room above the crowds] Take the lift to the fifth floor of a busy Sanjo-dori building and step into a white, jazz-playing room hung with wire art made for the café by Koichiro Tokumochi. The coffee is roasted in-house over direct flame and brewed cup by cup: the Ashijima Blend or the house medium-roast "Hyakunen Coffee", with a cake chosen to match — the rice-flour Sanjo cheesecake is gluten-free. Staff ask about allergies and serve with bar-like polish. Coffee and cake about ¥1,600; no reservations; open daily.

roles: Owner-roaster; not named in the sources read
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: coffee roasted in small batches on a direct-flame roaster to suit every taste, from bitter to acidic to strong; the group runs 喫茶葦島, 葦島珈琲 (a café in Kyoto Takashimaya S.C.), the takeaway shop 葦 and the café das, and sells beans and cheesecakes online. An October 2026 review notes wire art by Koichiro Tokumochi made for the café. Tabelog Kissaten "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2022, 2026; opened 15 May 2010.
chef_bio.philosophy: Coffee that pursues the beans' own flavour, in a calming space (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: House-roast coffee; Sanjo cheesecake.

anecdotes.text: "Only high-quality domestic ingredients, including rice flour, are used to carefully express the goodness of the materials. It is gluten-free." — October 2026, the Sanjo cheesecake.
"The staff kindly checked for any allergies." — October 2026.
"Although Sanjo is a lively street, once you reach the 5th floor, a tranquil space unfolds" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ashijimacoffee.com): 葦島珈琲、自家焙煎珈琲と厳選スイーツ、直火式焙煎機で少量ずつ焙煎、喫茶葦島・葦島珈琲 (京都髙島屋 S.C.)・葦 (テイクアウト専門)・das (カフェ)、喫茶葦島は平日12:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、火曜12:00〜17:00 (L.O.16:30)、土日11:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、予約不可、中京区大黒町37 文明堂ビル5階。食べログ: 喫茶店・カフェ・ケーキ、20席 (カウンター8、テーブル6×2)、禁煙、車椅子可、カード・QUICPay・PayPay・Alipay 可、アレルギー表示・グルテンフリー対応、デカフェあり、食事はカレーのみ、2010年5月15日オープン、喫茶店百名店 2021・2022・2026。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): 米粉のグルテンフリーの Sanjo cheesecake、Hyakunen Coffee、店のためのワイヤーアート、アレルギーの確認。

kyoto_en_boca.gf_detail: Ask. Pizza is the focus (wheat dough), but the oven-roasted vegetable platters, prosciutto and salads are popular starters (2026 reviews).
kyoto_en_boca.vegan_detail: Ask. Oven-roasted vegetables are a signature, and the lotus-root pizza with pesto is made without cheese (September 2026); pesto may contain cheese, so check.
kyoto_en_boca.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–22:00 (last food order 21:00) on Mon, Thu and Fri; lunch 11:30–15:00 (last food order 14:00) on Sat and Sun; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations recommended; call before coming without one; same-day cancellation ¥3,000 (Tabelog). Lunch courses for two or more, à la carte also possible (September–October 2026). One drink per person at dinner (Tabelog). 6 counter seats in front of the wood oven and 27 at tables; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 7 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). Opened 12 December 2010 (Tabelog).
kyoto_en_boca.notes: [Pizza · Karasuma, vegetable pizza from a wood oven] The Kyoto branch of a pizzeria from Karuizawa, in a high-ceilinged, softly lit renovated townhouse. Sit at the counter in front of the wood-fired oven and watch dough stretched and slid in a metre away. Start with the platter of oven-roasted vegetables — the zucchini drips juice — then share half-and-half pizzas: the cult lotus root with pesto (no cheese), beef tendon and burdock, or Manganji pepper with chirimen sansho. Lunch at weekends, dinner Monday, Thursday and Friday; book ahead. About ¥4,000–6,000 a head.

roles: Branch of en boca; no person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: the Kyoto branch of a pizzeria whose main shop is in Karuizawa; a Yoyogi-Uehara branch in Tokyo has closed; set in a renovated machiya with a wood-fired oven. Tabelog Pizza "Tabelog 100" 2017–2019, 2021, 2023, 2025; opened 12 December 2010.
chef_bio.specialty: Lotus-root pizza; oven-roasted vegetables.

anecdotes.text: "Even though it was a pizza without cheese, the dough was surprisingly tasty" — September 2026, the lotus-root half.
"Right in front of me, the wood crackles and burns, and I watched as they added logs to the oven" — October 2026, at the counter.
"It is the Kyoto branch of a place that has its main store in Karuizawa." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: エンボカ 京都 (en boca Kyoto)、ピザ・野菜料理・肉料理、中京区西洞院六角下ル池須町406、烏丸駅から徒歩7分、月・木・金 17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、土・日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)、火・水休み、予約可 (当日キャンセルは3,000円)、予約なしの場合は電話を、ディナーは1ドリンク制、カウンター6席・テーブル27席、貸切20〜50名、カード・交通系 IC・PayPay 可、2010年12月12日オープン、ピザ百名店 2017〜2019・2021・2023・2025。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 軽井沢が本店、町家を改装、薪窯、蓮根のピザ、窯焼き野菜、ハーフ&ハーフ。

kyoto_nominokoji_yamagishi.gf_detail: Ask. A Japanese izakaya with soy- and miso-based dishes, fried items and shumai; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nominokoji_yamagishi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi, fish and meat throughout (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nominokoji_yamagishi.hours_raw: From 16:00, Mon, Tue, Thu–Sat and holidays, last food order 23:30 (Tabelog says 16:00–23:30); Sunday is listed with a last food order of 23:00 but no opening time; closed Wednesday and irregularly (Tabelog). Because Sunday has no opening time and the closing time after last order is not given, no hours are stored. Reservations accepted, by phone or online; more than an hour late counts as a cancellation (Tabelog). A course of four omakase dishes for ¥8,800, then à la carte; the menu shows no prices (October 2026). 12 seats: a counter of 10 and a table for 2 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 28 July 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nominokoji_yamagishi.notes: [Izakaya · City Hall, the casual side of a celebrated kappo] The open-kitchen izakaya of Kyoto's Tomikoji Yamagishi: ten counter seats where you start with four omakase dishes (¥8,800) and then order whatever you like — grilled Densuke anago, ikura rice, Spanish mackerel with miso, fried Matsutake, autumn oden, shumai. The sake list is long and the staff will scale portions for a light appetite. Many guests are from overseas. The menu shows no prices, so ask before ordering wine by the glass. About ¥10,000–19,999 with drinks; open late; closed Wednesdays.

Tabelog: opened 28 July 2022; Izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2024–2026.

kyoto_ludens.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Italian courses with ravioli and risotto alongside medicinal soups and vegetable plates; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ludens.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable-rich medicinal courses, but prosciutto and meat appear (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ludens.hours_raw: Lunch from 12:00 and dinner from 18:00 or 19:00, everyone starting together (official site; Tabelog); Tabelog gives Tue–Sat 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:30, closed Monday. The official site gives Sunday and Monday as closing days. A medicinal breakfast (Sat 7:00–9:00, Sun 8:00–11:00 per Tabelog; ¥2,800 in September 2026) is temporarily unavailable from 11 October 2026 (September 2026 review). Reservation only; online bookings are confirmed by phone; lunch takes about 2 hours, dinner about 2.5 (Tabelog). Chef's counter "田淵薬膳研究所": a seasonal course matched to your condition, lunch from 13:00 and dinner from 20:00 when counter seats are free (official site). Cards (Tabelog). 6 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 19 September 2017 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ludens.notes: [Italian · Marutamachi, medicinal-herb Italian] On a street near Nijo once lined with herbal-medicine wholesalers, a renovated townhouse serves Italian food built around nourishing, yakuzen-style ingredients: a medicinal soup to start, a plate of vegetables, ravioli, a chestnut risotto, with herbs and spices you grind at the table to suit how you feel. At the chef's counter, 田淵薬膳研究所, chef 田淵 — a qualified practitioner of Japanese-Chinese medicinal cooking — tailors a seasonal course to the day's condition. Diners praise the detailed explanations and warm send-off. Booking only; closed Mondays (and Sundays per the official site); the popular breakfast is paused from 11 October 2026.

chef_bio.chef_name: 田淵 (surname only; official site: "和漢薬膳食医の田淵シェフ"; no romaji in a source)
roles: Chef at the 田淵薬膳研究所 counter; a 和漢薬膳食医 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the name echoes "Ristorante", from ristorare, "to restore with food and rest"; Nijo-dori to the south once thrived with herbal-medicine wholesalers, a history the restaurant carries on with medicinal cooking; Italian-based courses rich in nourishing ingredients; a mail-order medicinal hot-pot set with a soup kept going for eight years, Kyoto Ohara vegetables and Miyagi "kampo" beef. Tabelog: opened 19 September 2017; Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: A place to relieve daily fatigue and restore energy (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal medicinal course; medicinal soups.

anecdotes.text: "According to the seasonal changes and my health, I was able to grind various medicinal herbs and spices (Chinese medicinal ingredients) that were blended into the dish." — October 2026.
"I also appreciated being able to take home the spices used in the dishes to enjoy at home." — August 2026.
"*Please note that breakfast will be temporarily unavailable from October 11, 2026." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ludens-kyoto.net): 薬膳イタリアン LUDENS、心と身体が喜ぶ素材を活かしたイノベーティブ・フュージョン、Ristorante の語源 Ristorare は「食事や休養で元気を回復させる」、南の二条通はかつて薬種問屋で栄えた街、イタリア料理をベースに滋養のある食材のコース、シェフズカウンター「田淵薬膳研究所」では和漢薬膳食医の田淵シェフが体調に合わせた「季節の養生コース」、ランチ13時〜・ディナー20時〜 (カウンターに空きがある場合)、薬膳茶から、アミューズ4種と野菜プレートと薬膳スープ、薬酒やハーブのドリンク、お取り寄せの養生鍋セット、昼12:00一斉スタート、夜18:00・19:00一斉スタート、日曜・月曜定休。食べログ: イタリアン・イノベーティブ、中京区間之町通二条上ル夷町560-8、丸太町駅から徒歩6分、予約のみ、昼は約2時間・夜は約2.5時間、2017年9月19日オープン、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 薬膳イタリアン、その場で挽くスパイス、薬膳の朝食は2026年10月11日から休止、丁寧な説明と見送り。
